chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from one of his companions, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Muawiya ibn Wahb, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

Regarding the Words of Allah, Mighty and Majestic: 'And let those who do not find the means to marry keep chaste until Allah makes them self-sufficient out of His Grace.' He (peace be upon him) said: 'They should keep marrying until Allah enriches them from His Grace.'
ai.seo_question: What does it mean to 'keep chaste' until Allah makes one self-sufficient according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) offers a nuanced interpretation of Surah An-Nur 24:33, clarifying that the command to 'keep chaste' does not mean remaining celibate until wealth is acquired, but rather actively seeking marriage while awaiting Allah's provision. This view underscores the Shia scholarly understanding that marriage is a means of sustaining chastity and that financial readiness is a dynamic state facilitated by divine grace rather than a static prerequisite. The narration highlights the practical implication that believers should pursue marriage as a spiritual and social duty, trusting that Allah will enrich them from His bounty.

en.hubeali: Abu Ali Al Ashary, from one of his companions, from Safwan Bin Yahya, from Muawiya Bin Wahab,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [24:33] And let those who do not find the means to marry keep chaste until Allah makes them self-sufficient out of His Grace. Heasws said: ‘They should keep marrying until Allahazwj Enriches them from Hisazwj Grace’.
en.sarwar: 7. Abu Ali al-Ash’ariy has narrated from certain persons of his people from Safwan ibn Yahya from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following: “About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘Those who cannot find marriage must remain chaste until Allah through His generosity makes them self-sufficient,’ [24:33] he (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘They must become married so that (when) Allah makes them self- sufficient through His generosity.’”
